name: Kaju Katli
description: Thin diamonds of cashew fudge, finished with edible silver leaf.

name: Rasgulla
description: Soft, spongy chhena balls simmered in light sugar syrup.
origin_story: Popularised in Kolkata in the 1860s; Odisha has its own centuries-old version served at the Puri temple.
